description: Read the repository on this machine and return its structural facts: database tables and their row-level security policies (from SQL migrations or a Prisma schema), Next.js routes, and clusters of related files per route. Runs locally with no network call and no model, and sends nothing to VibeMap. The same code always gives the same facts. Use each cluster's id and files when you write the spec for vibemap_import_semantic.

localPath.description: Absolute path to the repository (defaults to the directory the server runs in)

name: vibemap_extract_repo_facts
